about: a talk about home composting; the actor returns one item with the video's transcript

body.title: Composting at Home: The 3 Mistakes Everyone Makes
body.transcript: Hi everyone, today we're talking about home composting. The first mistake is too many greens: kitchen scraps need roughly two parts browns, like dry leaves or cardboard, for every part greens. The second mistake is letting the pile dry out; it should feel like a wrung-out sponge. The third is never turning it. Turn the pile every week or two to get air in, and you'll have finished compost in about three months instead of a year.
